svg.title: Rules first, then AI: where VirtualPyTest uses AI and why, in one image
svg.text: AI IN THE LAB · WHERE AND WHY
Most of the lab runs on rules. A model is asked only when a rule is not sure.
Four jobs, mostly free. Numbers checked on 22 Nov 2026.
Most of it needs no AI
A rule or a clock is enough
Localize, KPIs, detection, navigation and repair use no model at all.
A person only looks at real problems
A frozen menu, a sleeping phone, a network blink: set aside.
Job 2: name what is on screen
When the fingerprint is not sure
The second opinion on a match is mostly logged: it changes nothing yet.
A person reviews what is written.
Questions about the tool, a screen or a run
Plus showcases: game bots and the drone prove the same look-and-press loop.
one per job, plus a fallback
Every cloud call is logged and shown on the AI usage page.
The whole lab, the last 30 days
Cheap on purpose: rules first, small models next, strong models last.
Menu or stuck video, without a language model
See the poster Freeze: menu or stuck video? The word model is measured, not wired yet.
Rules first. AI where a rule cannot decide.
Every answer is logged, so you can measure what AI really adds.
